title: Hold focus in every openOverlay sheet, not dialog by dialog
notes: help, worktree-view, chat-btw-view, board-detail and settings-view open a sheet through openOverlay without holdFocus, so Shift+Tab walks the focus out to the pane behind them and the next Escape reaches that pane (found in review of PR #298). Root-cause fix: openOverlay calls holdFocus and its remove() releases it; then drop the explicit pairs in confirmOverlay, promptOverlay (keep its hold on the input), viewerOverlay, update-view, whats-new-view and anchored-popup, and the 'a dialog that does not stop Tab' sentence in docs/keys/hard-rules.md. Hand-check each sheet, inputs inside board-detail/settings/filter and a sheet opened over another.

comments.body: Done in #298 instead (https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/298): the hold moved into openOverlay there.
